g.text: McMaster Children’s Hospital/McMaster University Medical Centre is located at 1200 Main Street West, Hamilton. On Level 2 (ground level), there are elevators, an
information desk, gift shop, coffee shop, and children’s emergency department. The main entrance and emergency department entrance are wheelchair accessible. There
are underground and above-ground parking options with accessible parking spaces. For information about specific locations, please call your clinic’s extension or the main
hospital switchboard at 905.521.2100. When you arrive, please visit the information desk in the main lobby if you require assistance.
